summary: Defensive pipeline hooks for eight optional community sources (nearcade, hkrgm2, hkarcade, mgm_tw, musecat, otogesetchi, timezone, insert_coin). merge.py loads data_raw/<slug>.json when present (list or wrapped dict), assigns SRC_PRIORITY 7+, treats them as community for geo_validate, and teaches counts honesty via community_qty (with aliases like musecat_quantity and auto-tag for inventory sources). run_all registers optional scrapers only under --only (never default full scrape); missing modules skip; scrape() may return (rows, meta). Docs section 12 documents the contract. No production optional raw JSON on disk yet; hkrgm2.py and musecat.py modules exist from parallel agents; smoke_hkrgm2.json is not production path.
how_to_verify: python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'scrapers'); import merge; print(merge.OPTIONAL_COMMUNITY_SOURCES); print({k: merge.SRC_PRIORITY[k] for k in merge.OPTIONAL_COMMUNITY_SOURCES})"
python scrapers/run_all.py --only nearcade  (expect: optional nearcade module not present (skipped) when scraper absent)
python scrapers/run_all.py --only hkrgm2  (runs scraper if network ok; writes data_raw/hkrgm2.json)
Copy or scrape into data_raw/hkrgm2.json then: python scrapers/run_all.py --skip-scrape  (merge log should say loading optional source hkrgm2)
Synthetic unit path verified in agent session: load_units + merged_entry with smoke_hkrgm2 schema and musecat_quantity alias
risks: js/markers.js TRUSTED_COUNTS still only bemanicn|ziv: optional counts_src labels publish in arcades.json but map markers may not treat them as trusted until UI is updated.
timezone is intentionally excluded from OPTIONAL_COUNT_AUTO_EVIDENCE so assumed chain lineups do not invent community_qty.
hkrgm2.scrape returns (rows, origin); run_all unwraps tuples. Other scrapers should return a bare list or a one-element tuple of rows.
Accidental full merge during verification rewrote data/arcades.json + share pages with no optional rows present (same core sources); not a data expansion.
nearcade/hkarcade/mgm_tw/otogesetchi/timezone/insert_coin scrapers not landed yet; hooks only fire after their JSON or --only scrape exists.
Cross-source merge uses existing 120 m / name-sim rules only; nearcade vs bemanicn dense CN clusters may need future china_colocated extension if false non-merges appear.
